deliveredIncrements.notes: Implementation files: Services/IUploadValidator.cs (NEW — interface + sealed DefaultUploadValidator; UploadValidationOutcome enum {Valid, EmptyFile, PathTraversalRejected, ExtensionRejected, MagicByteRejected}; allowed-extension HashSet {.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .bmp}; ValidateAsync flow: empty -> path-traversal -> extension allowlist -> Image.IdentifyAsync magic-byte check via SixLabors.ImageSharp -> Valid; GenerateSanitizedFileName: course_{courseId}_{Guid('N')[..8]}{ext.ToLowerInvariant()}); Controllers/CoursesController.cs (NEW — Index/Details/Create/Edit/Delete + Image actions; class-level [Authorize(Roles=Admin,Reader)]; per-action [Authorize(Roles=Admin)] for Create/Edit/Delete POSTs; MaxUploadBytes=5_242_880; UploadDirectoryRelativePath='App_Data/uploads/teaching-materials'; PersistUploadAsync writes to App_Data/uploads/teaching-materials; Image action returns PhysicalFile with Content-Disposition: attachment to defeat inline-render attacks; path-traversal defense via absolutePath.StartsWith(uploadRoot + sep) belt-and-braces check; [RequestSizeLimit(MaxUploadBytes)] on Create + Edit POSTs); Views/Courses/{Index,Details,Create,Edit,Delete}.cshtml (5 NEW — Bootstrap 5 with Admin-only buttons, file input with accept='.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.bmp', multipart form for Create + Edit); Program.cs MODIFIED (early Content-Length middleware between UseStaticFiles and UseRouting that short-circuits POST /Courses/Create + POST /Courses/Edit/* with HTTP 413 BEFORE the MVC pipeline runs antiforgery validation — see lessons below; AddSingleton<IUploadValidator, DefaultUploadValidator> registration); ContosoUniversity.Web.csproj MODIFIED (SixLabors.ImageSharp 3.1.5 added). SEC-HIGH-002 defenses (5 layers): (1) early Content-Length middleware -> HTTP 413 oversize, (2) IUploadValidator extension allowlist, (3) IUploadValidator magic-byte verification via Image.IdentifyAsync, (4) IUploadValidator path-traversal rejection + GUID-based sanitized filename, (5) Image action GetFullPath StartsWith uploadRoot defense-in-depth re-check + Content-Disposition: attachment forces download. CRITICAL LESSON LEARNED: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ViewFeatures.ValidateAntiforgeryTokenAuthorizationFilter (the IFilterFactory product of [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]) is IAsyncAuthorizationFilter with Order=1000 and calls _antiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync UNCONDITIONALLY — does NOT check if context.Result was already set by an earlier-Order authorization filter. ReadFormAsync throws InvalidDataException on form-size overflow, antiforgery catches it as AntiforgeryValidationFailedResult (400). Therefore filter-level oversize 413 protection is IMPOSSIBLE when antiforgery is enabled — MUST use middleware before MVC pipeline (and before UseRouting). Earlier 3-attempt iteration: (a) IAsyncResourceFilter with [PayloadTooLarge] — runs after authorization -> antiforgery already failed; (b) IAuthorizationFilter Order=int.MinValue — runs first AND sets Result=413, BUT antiforgery clobbers Result with 400; (c) inline middleware before UseRouting — bypasses MVC pipeline entirely, WORKS. Carry-forward TODOs: SixLabors.ImageSharp 3.1.5 has known vulnerabilities (NU1903 high GHSA-2cmq-823j-5qj8 + NU1902 moderate GHSA-rxmq-m78w-7wmc) — evaluate Magick.NET / SkiaSharp / newer ImageSharp version; SRI integrity hashes for jsDelivr CDN (Bootstrap 5.3.3 + jQuery 3.7.1) still pending from rw-002; rw-004 AC#7 test-isolation gap (cumulative POST /Students/Create rows pollute pageSize=3 page-1 boundary) — followup to add scenario-scoped DB cleanup hook OR unique LastName w/ deletion; NotificationService calls intentionally NOT ported in rw-005 (defer to rw-007).
